summary: Wise Group plc filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's current report) disclosing the poll results of its Annual General Meeting held 24 September 2026. All eight ordinary resolutions passed, including receiving FY2026 audited financial statements, appointing PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP as auditors, electing directors Bolling Wells, Thomassin, Duhon and Tan, and authorising share buybacks; support ranged from 97.54% to 99.99%. Computershare served as scrutineer. A structural note: founder Kristo Käärmann's Class B voting rights were capped at one vote below 50%, reducing exercisable voting rights to 2,316,423,151 from 2,801,291,035. No special-situation event; watch only the buyback authority's future deployment.
